exams.name: Standard Chiropractic Examination
exams.notes: Oral, practical and written examination covering anatomy, physiology, histology, chemistry, pathology, physics, bacteriology, diagnosis, hygiene and sanitation, symptomatology, chiropractic analysis, X-ray, chiropractic principles and practical demonstration. Passing score is 75% overall or 75% on oral/practical plus passing score on NBCE written.
exams.jurisdiction: state board (administered by qualified professional testing organization)
exams.quote: The examination shall be oral, practical and written, upon the principles and technique of chiropractic and shall include the following subjects: anatomy, physiology, histology, chemistry, pathology, physics, bacteriology, diagnosis, hygiene and sanitation, symptomatology, chiropractic analysis, X-ray, chiropractic principles and a practical demonstration of chiropractic technique.

exams.name: National Board of Chiropractic Examiners (NBCE) written examination
exams.notes: An alternative path to the written portion; applicant may use the NBCE passing score in lieu of the state written exam score when combined with 75% on oral and practical.
exams.quote: an average score of at least 75% on the oral and practical examination and a passing score on the written examination administered by the National Board of Chiropractic Examiners as such passing score is determined by the national board.

interval_years.quote: A license shall be renewed biennially for a period of two years upon payment of the biennial fee

required.quote: As a condition for the biennial renewal of a license to practice chiropractic, a licensee shall submit to the board evidence that he has completed at least 24 hours of continuing chiropractic education within the immediately preceding two-year period

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to: Engage or attempt to engage in the practice of chiropractic or to hold himself out as a practitioner of chiropractic unless he has first fulfilled the requirements of this act and has been licensed by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license contained in the act or board regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license contained in this act or regulations of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent representations in the practice of chiropractic.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent representations in the practice of chiropractic.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing fraud or deceit in obtaining a license to practice chiropractic.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing fraud or deceit in obtaining a license to practice chiropractic.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Displaying gross incompetence, negligence or misconduct in carrying on the practice of chiropractic.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Displaying gross incompetence, negligence or misconduct in carrying on the practice of chiropractic.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitting a false or deceptive biennial registration to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submitting a false or deceptive biennial registration to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of a felony or misdemeanor in the practice of chiropractic, or receiving certain dispositional alternatives in felony charges.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of a felony, a misdemeanor in the practice of chiropractic, or receiving probation without verdict, disposition in lieu of trial or an Accelerated Rehabilitative Disposition in the disposition of felony charges

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice chiropractic suspended, revoked or refused, or receiving other disciplinary action by another jurisdiction's chiropractic licensing authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice chiropractic suspended, revoked or refused or receiving other disciplinary action by the proper chiropractic licensing authority of another state, territory, possession or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice chiropractic with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance abuse, or mental or physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice chiropractic with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, drunkenness, excessive use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals or any other type of material, or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a lawful regulation promulgated by the board or a lawful order of the board previously entered in a disciplinary proceeding.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a lawful regulation promulgated by the board or violating a lawful order of the board previously entered in a disciplinary proceeding.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring or advising any unlicensed person to practice chiropractic contrary to this act or board regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring or advising any unlicensed person to practice chiropractic contrary to this act or regulations of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing immoral or unprofessional conduct, including departure from acceptable and prevailing chiropractic practice standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing immoral or unprofessional conduct. Unprofessional conduct shall include any departure from, or failure to conform to, the standards of acceptable and prevailing chiropractic practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting professional services engagements through coercion, duress, compulsion, intimidation, threats, overreaching or harassing conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting any engagement to perform professional services by any direct, in-person or uninvited soliciting through the use of coercion, duress, compulsion, intimidation, threats, overreaching or harassing conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to perform any statutory obligation placed upon a licensed chiropractor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to perform any statutory obligation placed upon a licensed chiropractor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally submitting to a third-party payor a claim for a service or treatment not actually provided to a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally submitting to any third-party payor a claim for a service or treatment which was not actually provided to a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain chronological documentation of patient care in accordance with board regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain chronological documentation of patient care in accordance with regulations prescribed by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making representations that chiropractic treatment will cure cancer or an infectious or communicable disease.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making representations that chiropractic treatment will cure cancer or an infectious or communicable disease.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holding oneself out as a specialist without possessing a postgraduate certification in that specialty.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Holding himself out as a specialist unless he possesses a postgraduate certification in that specialty.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unconditionally guaranteeing that a cure will result from the performance of chiropractic treatment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unconditionally guaranteeing that a cure will result from the performance of chiropractic treatment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to refer a patient to another licensed healing arts practitioner when diagnosis indicates referral is appropriate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to refer a patient to a licensed practitioner of another branch of the healing arts for consultation or treatment when a diagnosis of such patient indicates that such a referral is appropriate.

insurance_required.quote: As a condition for obtaining or renewing a license to practice chiropractic in this Commonwealth beginning with the 1988 license renewal period, an applicant shall submit to the board satisfactory evidence that he has obtained professional liability insurance, or that he has established self-insurance for professional liability, in the minimum amount of $100,000 per occurrence and $300,000 per annual aggregate.

definition_quote.value: A branch of the healing arts dealing with the relationship between the articulations of the vertebral column, as well as other articulations, and the neuro-musculo-skeletal system and the role of these relationships in the restoration and maintenance of health.
definition_quote.quote: A branch of the healing arts dealing with the relationship between the articulations of the vertebral column, as well as other articulations, and the neuro-musculo-skeletal system and the role of these relationships in the restoration and maintenance of health.

adjustment or manipulation of such misaligned or displaced vertebrae and other articulations
furnishing of necessary patient care for the restoration and maintenance of health
use of board-approved scientific instruments of analysis, including X-ray

drug_authority.value: Drugs are explicitly excluded from the chiropractic scope of practice.
drug_authority.quote: The term shall not include the practice of obstetrics or gynecology, the reduction of fractures or major dislocations, or the use of drugs or surgery.

adjunctive_procedures_certification_requ.quote: after January 1, 1988, the licensee must be certified in accordance with this act to use adjunctive procedures

value: Passed a licensing examination that included the use of adjunctive procedures
Passed an examination on the use of adjunctive procedures prepared and administered by a qualified and approved professional testing organization
Completed a minimum of 100 hours of study in the use of adjunctive procedures as approved by the board
Used adjunctive procedures in licensed chiropractic practice for three years immediately preceding the effective date of this act
adjunctive_procedures_certification_path.quote: passed an examination for licensure to practice chiropractic, which examination included the use of adjunctive procedures; passed an examination on the use of adjunctive procedures; completed a minimum of 100 hours of study in the use of adjunctive procedures, as approved by the board; or used adjunctive procedures in the licensed practice of chiropractic for three years immediately preceding the effective date of this act

adjunctive_procedures_defined.quote: Physical measures such as mechanical stimulation, heat, cold, light, air, water, electricity, sound, massage and mobilization.

value: reduction of fractures or major dislocations
explicitly_excluded_practices.quote: The term shall not include the practice of obstetrics or gynecology, the reduction of fractures or major dislocations, or the use of drugs or surgery.

imaging_authorized.quote: the use of board-approved scientific instruments of analysis, including X-ray.

diagnosis_authorized.quote: The term shall also include diagnosis, provided that such diagnosis is necessary to determine the nature and appropriateness of chiropractic treatment

referral_obligation.quote: Failing to refer a patient to a licensed practitioner of another branch of the healing arts for consultation or treatment when a diagnosis of such patient indicates that such a referral is appropriate.

unlicensed_supportive_personnel_permitte.quote: Nothing in this act shall prohibit a licensed chiropractor from utilizing the assistance of unlicensed supportive personnel performing under the direct on-premises supervision of a licensed chiropractor

student_practice_exemption.quote: This section does not apply to a student enrolled in a chiropractic education program at a chiropractic college approved by the board in accordance with section 303, provided that: the student is conducting chiropractic activities as part of the curriculum established by the chiropractic college; and the student is under the direct, immediate and personal supervision of a chiropractor licensed by the board.
